intro: Pack your bags, it's time to travel!
description:
Discover iconic landmarks, hidden courtyards, and the unique charm of European cities, all from the comfort of your home.

What's new in Trip to Europe 13:
- Every scene is crafted with meticulous attention to architectural authenticity and cultural context. Dozens of carefully hidden objects await your sharp eye.
- Enhanced search modes — Expanded task types, dynamic hints, and interactive elements breathe life into every image and keep gameplay engaging.
- Mini games and puzzles — Logic, observation, and memory challenges are seamlessly woven into your journey for a satisfying change of pace.
- Souvenir collection — Purchase memorable keepsakes that reflect the traditions, crafts, and spirit of each country you visit.
- Postage stamps — A commemorative stamp awaits you on every location. Fill your album to unlock exclusive bonuses.
